messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: p99 latency spike detected for hosted-gpu-pool-17 in us-west-2. p95 480ms -> 2.1s, p99 1.2s -> 6.8s, streaming stalls increased 18% in last 5m. SLOs breached for customer tier 'standard'. trace_id=ab12cd34, affected hosts: host-gpu-17a, host-gpu-17b
lee - oncall: Ack. paging now. checking dashboards and traces.
sasha - infra: looking at cgroup stats on host-gpu-17a, I/O wait is high, device util ~92%, writeback spikes. suspect noisy tenant doing heavy KV writes.
jordan - runtime: confirmed increased kv-cache eviction on pool-17, tail latency surges correlate with eviction logs. Dumping top tenants by IO.
maya - support: any known customer impact yet? support pages coming in for customers A and B complaining slow streaming.
lee - oncall: customers A/B affected, approx 7% of requests for those orgs saw stalls > 5s. Put customer impact note in the incident channel and pinged SEs.
anita - eng-sre: propose mitigation: 1) QoS cgroup tighten on noisy tenant, 2) temporarily drain streaming sessions off host-gpu-17a to another host in pool, 3) enable immediate KV-prefetch bypass for streaming paths. Can we do step 2 quickly?
sasha - infra: I can adjust cgroup throttle levels now. command: sudo cgset -r blkio.throttle.read_bps_device=\"8:0 10485760\" /cgroup/tenant-4321 (example). Will do limited throttle for tenant-4321.
jordan - runtime: Can we route new streaming sessions to pool-19 (lower utilization) while we evacuate? We have compatible model variants there. I'll update smart-routing policy with a temporary route: 
```
patch routing policy:
match: pool==gpu-pool-17 AND streaming==true
action: prefer pool-19 weight=100 for 10m
```
lee - oncall: make it short TTL. Start with cgroup throttle + routing change. Notify customers.
maya - support: sent interim status to affected customers: "We're seeing intermittent streaming stalls, routing a portion of traffic to alternate hosts. Engineers are mitigating; will update in 10m."
ops-bot: deploy job started: pool-19 acceptor bump + route patch by jordan (job id job-202603151122).
sasha - infra: applied blkio throttle to tenant-4321 on host-gpu-17a and host-gpu-17b. Observed immediate drop in writeback.
jordan - runtime: route patch applied. New session creation rate to pool-19 increased, currently 45% of new streaming sessions routed away.
anita - eng-sre: monitoring p95/p99 now. p95 dropped from 2.1s -> 610ms in 3m, p99 still at ~1.8s but trending down. streaming stalls rate down from 18% -> 6%. good signal.
lee - oncall: good. keep throttles in place for 15m. plan drain: cordon host-gpu-17a for new streaming sessions, then gracefully migrate active sessions where possible. Jordan coordinate migration.
jordan - runtime: starting graceful eviction on host-gpu-17a: command: ./evacuate-host --host host-gpu-17a --max-concurrent 40 --grace 30s. Will stream progress here.
maya - support: logged updated message to customers: "We have routed new traffic and are migrating sessions away from a congested host; delays may persist for active sessions but we expect recovery within 20 minutes."
incident-bot: EVENT: host evacuation job job-evac-7577772468 started (owner=jordan).
jordan - runtime: evac progress: 12/120 sessions migrated, 30s grace, 3 sessions failed reconnect -> retried.
sasha - infra: host-gpu-17a kernel IO stats showing lower queue depth now, read latency back to normal  ~1-2ms.
anita - eng-sre: p99 now 950ms, p95 430ms, stalls 3.1%. still some residual tail. Recommend leaving routing patch and throttle for additional 10m, then rollback one-by-one.
lee - oncall: Assign follow-up: open ticket to ask platform team to review tenant quota for KV workloads and add automated noisy-tenant detection. tagging @sasha, @anita.
maya - support: taking postmortem action: contact list prepared for affected accounts, offering credits and RCA when done.
jordan - runtime: evac finished for host-gpu-17a: 120/120 migrated, host cordoned. host-gpu-17b shows lower but still elevated IO: applying cgroup throttle there too.
sasha - infra: throttle applied to tenant-4321 on host-gpu-17b. both hosts now below 70% device util.
ops-bot: route patch TTL expiring in 8m, current route weight pool-19=50%.
anita - eng-sre: beginning rollback plan: step1 reduce throttle slack by 20% and observe 5m; step2 if stable remove route patch.
lee - oncall: summary for handoff to daytime oncall (anita): incident severity S2, cause: noisy-tenant KV write spikes causing IO saturation on shared GPU pool which led to KV cache evictions and streaming tail latency. Mitigations performed: blkio cgroup throttle on tenant-4321, evacuate host-gpu-17a, temporary routing to pool-19, graceful session migration. Current status: latency improving (p95 420ms p99 780ms), stalls 2.9%, routing still in place, throttles still in place. Follow-ups: quota review, add noisy-tenant detection alert, customer RCA.
anita - eng-sre: taking handoff. I'll monitor rollback and open follow-up tickets. please attach logs: /var/log/evac/job-evac-7577772468.log and traces ab12cd34.* for RCA.
lee - oncall: thanks all. leaving channel.
maya - support: will draft customer-facing timeline and post to incident tracker.
incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: SLOs restored for standard tier in us-west-2. monitoring will watch for 2h.
anita - eng-sre: closing action items assigned, will file postmortem and link here when available.
ops-bot: job job-evac-7577772468 archived.
